standard: C11 7.6 floating environment with actual target UCRT; conservative IEC arithmetic policy
reference_note: Real system <fenv.h> is included. No private standard header or substitute C library. These cases do not replace forced CAS-failure, concurrency or hardware trap acceptance.

cases.source:
#include <fenv.h>
_Static_assert(sizeof(fenv_t)==8,"UCRT environment ABI");_Static_assert(_Alignof(fenv_t)<=16,"support buffer alignment");_Static_assert(FE_ALL_EXCEPT==31,"UCRT exception mask");int main(void){return fesetenv(FE_DFL_ENV)==0?42:1;}

#include <math.h>
int main(void){double n=NAN;_Bool b=n;return n!=n&&b&&n!=0.0?42:1;}
int main(void){_Atomic double a=20;return (a+=22)==42?42:1;}

#include <fenv.h>
int other(void);int main(void){return other()&&fesetenv(FE_DFL_ENV)==0?42:1;}
__declspec(selectany) int f(void){return 1;}int main(void){return f();}

#pragma STDC FENV_ACCESS ON
#pragma STDC FENV_ACCESS OFF
#pragma STDC FENV_ACCESS DEFAULT
#pragma STDC FP_CONTRACT OFF
#pragma STDC FP_CONTRACT ON
#pragma STDC CX_LIMITED_RANGE OFF
int main(void){return 42;}

#pragma STDC FENV_ACCESS SOMETIMES
int main(void){return 42;}
